name: Euretta
source: This Euretta was artificially recreated by Esutajjio through technology of Bigot. Esutajjio's motives are unclear, but he managed to get an exact copy of Euretta, including her semi-demonic nature and black wings. New Retta turned out to be very kind and responsive girl, and she tried to help people in trouble, despite the fact that they treated her as an evil demon.
